buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The agency must bring the personnel for facility management at its own cost and risk, and the buyer sh all have no responsibility for this. The agency shall be responsible for ensuring that they are present re gularly on the working days and during the working hours of the respective buyer’s consignee. Irregular employees must be removed as per the buyer's representation and suitable new employees must be pr ovided immediately. 2. The agency shall be responsible for providing extra time/or additional personnel for contingent work/ser vice as and when required. During the various programs/events/dinner functions etc. held frequently at the Buyer’s consignee, employees must be allotted for the full day/half day as informed by the Buyer’s consignee. Under normal circumstances, the departments are closed on public holidays/second and four th Saturdays/Sundays, and those days shall not be counted as working days. In exceptional circumstanc es, if an employee is required to attend on a public holiday/second and fourth Saturday/Sunday, those d ays shall be counted as working days. 3. The agency must hold a Government-recognized registration, and a copy of such document must be enc losed as proof thereof. Also, the person engaging the agency must enclose a xerox copy of a ration card /PAN card/voter ID card/driving license for his/her identification. 4. The agency must have at least three years of experience of satisfactory outsourcing work for Governme nt / Semi-Government / Co-operative/Public Sector institutions / banks / hospitals / industrial companies etc. (Supporting evidence for this must be submitted.) 5. The employees of the agency allotted by the agency must behave courteously and must perform the wo rk assigned to them as per the appropriate standards, for which the agency shall be responsible. 6. If a need arises to change any service or time arrangement at the Buyer’s consignee due to requiremen ts, the agency shall be bound to do so. 7. If any injury/accident or death occurs to a service employee engaged during the contract period, the full responsibility shall be that of the agency, and this Buyer’s consignee shall have no responsibility therei n. 8. The agency must engage employees who are free from any infectious diseases, healthy and adult, as pe r Government rules. 9. The agency must engage a sufficient number of employees and must maintain a record of their attenda nce and movement. The agency must also comply with the policies and rules of the Buyer’s consignee. 10. The outsourcing contract shall be under the direct supervision of the Member Secretary, Gujarat Techn ical Education and Research Society (GTERS) and their sister concern respective consignee, and the wo rk/instructions given by them or by an officer/employee authorized by them must be carried out. The a gency must submit to the Member Secretary, Gujarat Technical Education and Research Society (GTER S) and their sister concern respective consignee, a list of the employees deployed, with photographs, co ntact numbers and home addresses. 11. Disputes regarding any matter relating to the agreement shall be settled within Gandhinagar jurisdicti on, and all responsibility regarding all laws/conditions relating to the Labour Commissioner shall be that of the contractor. Also, if income tax/GST and service tax are required to be deducted as per rules, that amount shall be deducted directly from the agency's bill by the Accounts Department, and any taxes of any kind, applicable now or in future, shall be borne by the contractor. 12. Employees engaged under the contract cannot demand any fund contribution. Also, if an employee of t he agency under the contract is caught committing any kind of irregularity in the Buyer’s consignee, the full responsibility shall be that of the agency, and if necessary, a police complaint will also be filed, and t he loss will be recovered from the agency's bill.

13. The agency shall be responsible for providing all employees of the agency with the prescribed uniform determined by the Buyer’s consignee. For the special identification of the agency's employees, they mu st come wearing their uniform and an identity card around the neck whenever they come every day to do the assigned work. 14. The agency shall be responsible for compliance with all Government laws relating to the provision of th e agency's employees, and the competent authority/Buyer’s consignee shall not be responsible in any c ircumstances for this. The responsibility for paying wages, in accordance with the provisions of the relev ant laws and rules, to the employees deployed to provide facility services under the agreement shall be entirely that of the agency. As per the Wages Act if applicable, the agency shall have to revise the rates according to the revisions made from time to time by the Government in wage rates. 15. The agency must comply with the applicable Labour Contract License and the rules of PF (PF) and ESIC. Copies of the documents relating to the said rules must be made available to the competent officer of t he Buyer’s consignee along with the bill at the time of payment of the bill. 16. There shall be no employer-employee relationship or any other legal liability between the Buyer’s cons ignee and the employees of the agency regarding employment and any matter incidental thereto. If an y questions arise from the agency's personnel regarding their service, the Buyer’s consignee shall have no concern whatsoever in any form. 17. The agency shall be responsible for taking the necessary insurance under a group/personal accident p olicy for the persons deployed by the agency. 18 The agency must get the police verification of the persons deployed by the agency done within 1 month of receiving the outsourcing work contract. 19 The agency is bound to compensate for all loss caused, directly or indirectly, to the property of the Buy er’s consignee, including wires and pipelines, or to any service, Government records, or the belongings of officers/employees, by the agency's persons due to their incompetence, negligence, or intentionally or for any other reason, or any loss that the Buyer’s consignee has to bear by the contact awardee age ncy. The agency or its persons shall not remove any material of the Buyer’s consignee without permissi on. 20 For complaints made by the Buyer’s consignee, the agency must maintain a register of complaints rece ived, in which the action taken must be recorded. A file with proof of complaint redressal must be maint ained. Necessary deductions will be made from the bill for incomplete work. 21 The agency must maintain a daily attendance report containing the details of the persons deployed on that day. The Buyer’s consignee will also separately take attendance. 22 The agency must submit the bill for the work by the fifth of the month following the relevant month. If t he work has not been done satisfactorily, payment will be made after deducting a penalty from the app roved monthly rate and deducting taxes as per rules from the payable amount. 23 The ePBG/Security Deposit amount shall be as per GeM and the Gujarat State Procurement Policy 2024. The Security Deposit amount must be submitted in the form of ePBG/Demand Draft in the name of Mem ber Secretary, Gujarat Technical Education and Research Society (GTERS) upon acceptance of the contr act order. The agency shall give an undertaking for this. The Security Deposit amount will be refunded t o the agency one month after the end of the contract period, if the performance is found satisfactory an d the bills are settled. No interest of any kind shall be payable on the ePBG/Security Deposit amount. 24 This contract is non-transferable. The agency cannot engage a sub-agency. No other matter of this age ncy can be transferred to any other agency. 25 The term of the outsourcing contract shall be eleven months from the date of commencement of the co ntract. Thereafter, if required, subject to satisfactory services by the agency, the outsourcing contract may be extended by a further eleven months by mutual consent at the same annual rate with minimu m one week break. Such extended contract agency cannot be transferred to a sub-agency. For all such intents and purposes, the “Service Provider” shall be the "Employer" within the meaning of different Rul

es & Acts in respect of manpower so deployed. The persons deployed by the Service Provider shall not have any claim whatsoever like employer and employee relationship against the Buyer. 26 If the agency fails to provide the outsourced man power service satisfactorily and there is no satisfactor y improvement in performance despite notice, the agency's security deposit will be forfeited and its ser vices will be terminated, for which 15 (fifteen) days' written notice will be given to wind up the man po wer contract. The Buyer’s consignee shall not be responsible for any expense, loss, or any other difficul ty arising from this. 27 Further, notwithstanding any provision in these conditions, the competent authority/Buyer’s consignee may terminate the agreement by giving the agency 15 (fifteen) days' written notice without assigning a ny reason, and no compensation shall be paid for the remaining period of an agreement terminated in t his manner. 28 The agency itself must pay, as per rules, the applicable prevailing taxes including Service Tax and Educ ation Cess, SC, PF, ESIC, GST, and bonus. It must also quote its rates taking into account other legal pro visions, including wages if applicable, for its employees. Furthermore, the payment of the employees en gaged must be made by the agency through the bank, and proof thereof must be provided to the Buyer ’s consignee every month. 29 In the event of the death of the owner of the agency, the agreement shall be deemed terminated and hi s/her legal heirs shall have no right/claim. Nevertheless, if the legal heirs of the owner of the agency wis h to continue this work at the fixed rates only, as per the terms and conditions of the agreement, they may continue this work with the consent of the authority/Buyer’s consignee. 30 Upon selection of the agency for providing outsourcing, the agreement must be executed on stamp pap er of prevailing amount as per law, and the expense for this shall be borne by the agency concerned. Th e said procedure must be completed within 15 days of the award of contract order. 31 The full authority to accept or not accept any price schedule shall rest with the Member Secretary, Guja rat Technical Education and Research Society (GTERS). 32 Immediately after permission to start work is granted, the man power concerned must be sent to start work in the same uniform as determined by the Buyer’s consignee, and the expense for this shall be bor ne by the agency concerned. 33 The agency shall be bound to provide the planning or any other details if asked for by the Buyer’s consi gnee to carry out work incidental to this agreement and the work. 34 If the agency's performance is not found satisfactory as per the tender conditions, this Buyer’s consigne e shall have the unrestricted right to impose a penalty without assigning any reason, and the agency wil l be blacklisted as per GeM rules. 35 After awarding the contract, Bidder/ Service Provider must strictly follow the wages described in the BID after necessary verification of the number of persons required for the daily work and payment of the wa ges to them. In the event that the contract is not awarded to any party, the decision of the Member Secr etary, Gujarat Technical Education and Research Society (GTERS) shall be final. 36 Bidder should provide manpower as per the Annexure – F and Consignee will have the power to increas e and decrease the manpower according to the requirement. 37 Every employee allotted by the agency to the Buyer’s consignee must perform duty as required during the working hours of the Buyer’s consignee. Part-time employees cannot be kept as per requirement. E very task shown in Annexure – A must be performed. The attendance sheet of the man power allotted b y the agency in the departments of the Buyer’s consignee must be maintained. In case of absence, the

Buyer’s consignee will count the total days of absence, calculate the amount at the prevailing daily rate , and recommend its deduction from the bill, and accordingly the total deduction will be made from the bill of the month concerned. 38 If any work allotted to the manpower is not completed within the stipulated time limit, then that work w ill be allocated by the buyer/ consignee to external agency without tendering process. The cost of such work will be deducted from the amount of the agency's monthly bill. No dispute or argument regarding this will be accepted. 39 All necessary documents, bills or details to be submitted with the bill, such as the amount payable to th e employees, the PF deduction of the agency's employees, a copy of the bank statement of the salaries paid, etc., must be submitted on time to time to each Buyer’s consignee. 40 During office hours, the agency must provide the necessary workers/manpower at its own cost whenev er a need arises for contingent additional work in any consignee department within the bid condition. A ny other additional manpower requirement more than in bid condition will be paid extra for time being when it is asked in written. If requirement arises is less than bid condition then paid less accordingly for that time period only. 41 The agency must create its own E-mail and check it regularly, redress the complaints received, inform t he concerned department officer of the redressal, maintain a record/register, and show it whenever the officer in charge asks for it. 42 From the time the work order is given to the agency, the work must be carried out as per the bid conditi ons, in the existing condition of the premises. 43 Under normal circumstances, the Buyer’s consignee will be closed on every second and fourth Saturday , Sunday or public holiday, but if any function/program/event is organized on those days, the employees of the agency must be present if so, informed by the department concerned. 44 The employees allotted by the outsourcing agency must perform their duties in compliance with the ins tructions given by the Government from time to time, taking into account epidemics and emergency sit uations. 45 One branch of the agency's office must necessarily be registered in Gujarat and must submit the necess ary documents as proof, such as the municipal tax receipt of the office, the applicable rent agreement a nd the electricity bill; otherwise, the bidder will be disqualified. 46 In any matter relating to this contract, the decision of the Member Secretary, Gujarat Technical Educati on and Research Society (GTERS) shall be considered final and must be accepted. 47 The outsourcing agency must submit a certificate stating that it has not previously been blacklisted by any Government institution or PSU, in the form of a copy certified by a notary after the date on which th e bid was announced. 48 Along with the bill of every month, documentary proof of the payment of the wages, ESIC, bonus, PF, et c. paid for the previous month must be provided; otherwise, the bill will not be paid. 49 Employees must be provided as per the number of employees and required qualifications shown in Ann exure – A. 50 Submission of false or incorrect information, reports of unprofessional conduct, amongst other things, s hall lead to disqualification of the bidder. 51 Bidders shall submit offers that comply with the requirements of the tender. Alternatives will not be con sidered unless specifically called for by the authority. 52 The manpower will be entitled to 01 leave per month which will be carry forwarded to next month if un used. Beyond specified leaves as applicable, leave will be treated as leave without pay (LWP) 53 The service provider/contractor shall be responsible for paying proportionate gratuity to contract labour who have rendered continuous service as per the provisions of the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972.

54 The manpower provided by the Service Provider shall not be deemed employees of the Buyer departme nt hence the compliance of the applicable acts/ laws will be the sole responsibility of the Service Provider. 55 The Service Provider shall furnish the following documents in respect of the manpower deployed by the m to Buyer's premise/ designated premise in the given time limit: i. List of persons deployed (monthly) ii. CV/Resume with Required details (at the time of deployment) iii. Copy of Aadhaar Card of the candidates (at the time of deployment) iv. Identity Cards issued by Service Provider bearing photograph (within 8 days of joini ng) v. Identity proof and residential proof (at the time of deployment) vi. Copy of police verification certificate (at the time of deployment) vii. Copy of birth certificate, if required (at the time of deployment - for domicile purpose ) viii. Details of PF Account Number of resources. 56 The Service Provider shall nominate a coordinator/ Single Point of Contact (SPOC) who shall be responsi ble for regular interaction with the Buyer Department so that optimal services of the persons deployed c ould be availed without any disruption. 57 In an event of deployed manpower availing leave, and if required by Buyer, suitable substitute(s) shall be provided by Service Provider as per mutual understanding with Buyer. Service Provider shall commu nicate the same to buyer in advance. 58 In case of any resource permanently leaving the agency or taking leave for a longer duration, service pr ovider shall communicate the same to buyer at least 1 month prior to the last working day of a resource s. Suitable substitute(s) shall be provided by Service Provider as per mutual understanding with buyer. 59 No medical facilities or reimbursement or any sort of medical claims thereof in respect of employees pr ovided by the Service Provider will be entertained by the Buyer. 60 For all intents and purposes, the “Service Provider” shall be the "Employer" within the meaning of differ ent Rules & Acts in respect of manpower so deployed. The persons deployed by the Service Provider sh all not have any claim whatsoever like employer and employee relationship against the Buyer. 61 No deployed manpower shall be allowed to stay in the Buyer's premise/ designated premise unnecessa rily after working hours without Buyer's permission. 62 The Service Provider shall be solely responsible for the redressal of grievances/ resolution of disputes r elating to persons deployed. The Buyer shall, in no way be responsible for settlement of such issues wh atsoever. 63 The Service Provider shall ensure regular payment to the deployed manpower to their entitlements like monthly salaries/ wages etc. and submit the documentary proof of the salary paid as per the terms and conditions of the contract. Bill for the subsequent month will be paid only after submission of certificate of disbursement of wages of previous month. 64 The Service Provider shall submit before the Buyer Department, one copy of the return within 7 days fro m the date of filing of monthly/ quarterly/ half yearly/ annual return if any before the EPF and ESI author ities. 65 All applicable taxes and duties other than mentioned in the contract document, shall be payable by the Service Provider and the Buyer shall not entertain any claims whatsoever with respect to the same. 66. The Service Provider, at all times, will ensure that the services being provided under this Contract/Agre ement are performed strictly in accordance with all applicable laws, order, byelaws, regulations, notifica

tions, guidelines, rules, standards, recommended practices etc. and no liability in this regard will be att ached to the Buyer. 67 Deductions: Deductions can be imposed by the Buyer for the following: Sr. No Violation / Condition 1st Instance 2nd / 3rd Instance 1 Non-deployment of total Up to 15 days: 1 day's wages of t Beyond 15 days: cancellation of co manpower mentioned in he resources not deployed, per d ntract with cancellation charges @ the contract as per date ay.
